lead: Herbal inhalers and balms (Poy Sian, Siang Pure, Peppermint Field) sold as souvenirs; a Thai everyday scent ritual.

lead: Korean intimate-area perfume line (8 scents such as Neroli, Pure Rose, White Musk) from your screenshot; body-care category, check safety claims before adding to Clay.

name: Friday Fragrance
lead: 'Deep Down' eau de parfum seen in your Korean perfume screenshots.

name: Naseem (Musk Tahara)
lead: UAE house of alcohol-free perfumes. Own shop: Musk Taharah and Bushra each AED 31.50 for 80 ml (Bushra: lemon, sage, cardamom, praline, cinnamon on musk and amber); Lamsa and Bushra also AED 15.75 for 200 ml. The small bottle creators show at about ₹300 in India is still unmatched.

name: toDefine (寓义)
lead: Chinese niche house; Bounty is a guava scent with buchu leaf, Timur pepper, freesia, lily of the valley and rose over sandalwood, sage and musk. Find price and shop.

name: Tomolab
lead: Teh Tjap Tomo (tea) and Absentease; 50 ml reported Rp225.000 to Rp329.000 on Shopee/Tokopedia. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee. Wild Erysimum: aldehydes, yellow florals and leather in a bottle with a handmade pottery cap; a creator says few local brands go in this direction. Wild Erysimum (2026) is by perfumer Maria Garcia: wallflower, aldehydes, galbanum, leather, oakmoss, rose, vetiver.

name: Alien Objects
lead: Luxury Jakarta house with bespoke service; 50 ml reported around Rp1.500.000. Also Osmanthus Blanc and Jade Oolong. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Amthra
lead: Orangelic, Soaphisticated, Matcha Punch; 50 ml extrait reported Rp210.000 to Rp269.000. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Anamcara
lead: Hello Anamcara (not Dusita's Anamcara): De Pistachio, Solvere, Grainee; 30 ml reported Rp89.000 to Rp196.000. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Saudade
lead: Saudade Olfactory: Hidden Shrine, Bonsai We Kept, Tangled Thread; 50 ml reported Rp305.000 to Rp368.000. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Shaia
lead: SHAIA Apothecary: Neroli, Moroccan Rose; 50 ml reported about Rp488.000. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Ur in Flores
lead: ur.thescent: 'Call me when ur in Flores' extrait; 10 ml reported Rp155.000, 50 ml Rp291.000. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: What We Do Is Secret
lead: Messy Sexy Just Rolled Out of Bed (Dominique Ropion); reported about US$145. Prices from an AI summary; check on Shopee.

name: Dee Parfums London
lead: Opulence: creamy vanilla, citrus, white flowers and salty sea air. Find price.

name: Banic
lead: 'Your Skin' eau de parfum, 10 ml; from a 'smell musky, like your skin but better' roundup. Find price.

name: Tasneem (50 ml)
lead: Floral-label musky skin scent from the same roundup; brand name on label unclear. Find price.

name: Ajmal Royal Misk Rijali
lead: Alcohol-free 10 ml musk oil, featured in skin-scent roundups. Find price.

name: Narcotica (Amber Radiance)
lead: Rum, amber and orange blossom on vanilla, ambergris and musk, by Mathilde Bijaoui. US$300 / 100 ml at Luckyscent; an AI summary says the brand shop matches.

name: Room 1015 (Kokoa Bang)
lead: New 2026: rose champagne, pear and lemon over magnolia, cocoa and myrrh, vanilla, tonka and benzoin. Reported €100 / 50 ml, €160 / 100 ml, €35 / 10 ml (AI summary; brand shop not reachable from here).

name: Gritti (Yasuni Amber)
lead: Venetian house. Orange, lavender and tobacco over caramel, vanilla, cedar and smoke. Reported €260 / 100 ml, €40 / 9 ml at retailers (AI summary).

name: Reinvented (Lunar Reverie)
lead: Extrait with saffron, cardamom, prune, licorice, cinnamon and white tea over amber, incense and suede. €198 / 75 ml on its own shop. A brand directory lists it as Italian (not confirmed by the brand).

name: Personal Chemistry (Spring Serendipity)
lead: Mandarin, jasmine and ylang; violet, freesia and lily of the valley; cedar and musk. A green, stemmy lily of the valley. Reported Rp879.000 / 50 ml, shown sold out when last indexed.

name: Earthora (The Tea)
lead: Pu'er tea, cardamom, melon and sugarcane with fig leaf, on white musk, woods and a touch of oud. Reported Rp368.000–385.200 / 50 ml (two different listings). A creator says she has never smelled anything like it.

name: Orsar (Transcendence)
lead: Iris, vanilla and marshmallow: earthy iris on warm creamy woods. Reported Rp652.500 / 80 ml on Shopee at 10% off (regular Rp725.000).

name: Nevernot x Kopi Kenangan (Kenangan Tea Blend)
lead: Coffee-chain collab: Earl Grey and bergamot, jasmine and geranium, on sandalwood, musk and pepper. Rp189.000 / 35 ml extrait (creator's figure, matched by an AI check of retailer listings).

name: Scent of Jarte (Bali Tea Escape)
lead: Indonesia Series: Bedugul green tea from Bali, osmanthus and oolong over mate and soft musk. Rp299.000 / 30 ml extrait (creator's figure, matched by an AI check of the shop).

name: Notts (Hatsukoi)
lead: Jasmine green tea with petitgrain, ylang, a milky peach heart, sandalwood and musk. Rp259.000 / 50 ml (sometimes Rp246.050 on promotion).

name: Fonds (Worn-out Shirt)
lead: Filipino skin-scent brand; says its perfumes are made in the Philippines by Tadhana Fragrances (also in the atlas), on sugarcane alcohol. Worn-out Shirt is the cotton one. Find prices.

name: Sunnies Fragrances
lead: Filipino colour-coded perfumes in cube bottles, seven shades from creamy coconut to tomato leaf and geranium. Reported ₱995 / 50 ml EDP and ₱595 / 80 ml hair and body mist.

name: Les Petits Plaisirs
lead: Budget French-made eaux de toilette (violet macaron, tiaré, cherry blossom, cotton, vanilla, matcha). Reported €2.79–5.49 at home in France; seen at about 1,650 DA in one Algerian shop, while other Algerian shops list 3,300–4,200 DA.

name: Hint (Cotton, Metaverse)
lead: 'Just showered' perfumes. Cotton: aldehydes, ozone, freesia and gardenia on soft musk. Metaverse: aldehydic red fruits, orange blossom and incense on honey and vetiver. Rp299.000 / 50 ml (creator).

name: Alchemist (Pink Laundry)
lead: Clean laundry with rose, lily of the valley and chamomile, powdery on sandalwood. Rp249.000 / 50 ml (creator).

name: Scents of Pluto (Cotton Juniper)
lead: Crisp linen: mandarin, freesia, juniper and cotton flower on cashmere wood, musk and vanilla. Rp399.000 / 50 ml (creator).

name: Scarlett (Cotton Hug)
lead: Very affordable soft-clean extrait with coconut, lily of the valley, violet and musk. Rp75.000 / 30 ml (creator).

name: Mykonos (Indonesia)
lead: Clean and gourmand budget line: Slow Living (lemon, bergamot, lavender, cotton musk) Rp199.000 / 50 ml; Sparkling Rosé extrait Rp99.000 / 15 ml; also Daydream and milk-drop gourmands. Prices from a creator.

name: Indonesian tea perfumes to try
lead: A creator who has tried 40+ tea scents recommends: Deepti Warm Morning and A Cup of Tea, Saka Teaphoria, Auctus Delicate Tea, Scentalgia Treats and Tea, Crusita's iced teas (Thai, lychee, peach, genmaicha), Earthora The Tea, Rodda White Jade. Find prices.

name: Rayhaan (Palawan)
lead: Fresh unisex aquatic with calamansi at its heart, inspired by the Philippine island of Palawan; a collaboration with Noel Thomas. Listed at 120 on the brand's shop (currency not shown, likely AED).

name: Gulf 'freshie' launches
lead: Swiss Arabian Echoes of St. Moritz (icy citrus and mountain-air extrait, US$111 on its shop); Sapil Musk to Dawn (airy creamy musk); Arabiyat Coral Reef (soapy amber white floral); Caneza Elara L'Musc; Khadlaj Auro Regalia (vanilla, not final yet). From a creator's preview.

name: Maison Asrar (Milky Way, Vanilla Voyage)
lead: Milk-caramel-vanilla and honeyed vanilla gourmands. AED 145 each on its own shop.

name: Paris Corner (Dulzura, Eshal Musk)
lead: UAE budget house; its own shop confirms the notes (100 ml) but shows no price. Dulzura Vanilla Envie: anise and ginger, almond and soft white flowers, vanilla and musk; a creator rates it 8.5/10. Eshal Musk: lotus, lily of the valley and caramel over violet, musk and vanilla, a 'bubble-bath clean' musk the same creator wore non-stop (9.5/10). Find price.

name: HEIR
lead: New Mumbai niche house (founder Priyanka Malhotra), blended in Spain; five EDPs sold on heirbeauty.com since July 2026. Nectra: rambutan, hibiscus and elderflower, a tart fruity musk. Miras: cardamom, orris and cacao, with jaggery per a creator. Creator says not blind-buy safe and shortish wear; try the discovery set. Its own shop (seen via indexed pages, not opened from here): discovery set ₹1,200 for five 2 ml vials; Nectra ₹4,500 / 50 ml; blended in Spain with perfumer Michael Nordstrand.

name: Liis (Choux Choux)
lead: Cream-puff gourmand: citrus peel, fresh cream and vanilla with salted caramel, named for the founder's French upbringing. US$178 / 50 ml on its own shop.

name: Ana Teodoro (Parfum)
lead: Brazilian business (Itumbiara, Goiás, founded 2023) that also does scent marketing for spaces and events; its Instagram shows numbered parfums like 01 Marcondes (100 ml). Check whether it sells personal perfume, then notes and price.

name: Glossy Dose (hair mists)
lead: Small Egyptian brand selling 120 ml hair mists at 280 EGP (buy 2 get 1): Cloud Kiss (floral, woody, citrus) and Bare Vanilla Bloom (powdery vanilla musk). Price from the brand's own comment.

name: Femmenina (hair & body mists)
lead: Bakery-style, alcohol-free hair and body mists: Crème Brûlée (vanilla milk jam, caramelised sugar, a hint of banana) US$18.50, Butter & Cinnamon Cake US$19.90, Musky Cinnamon. Prices in US$ per an AI check of the shop; creators note high shipping costs.

name: Unké Naru (Tesso Nilo)
lead: Named after Tesso Nilo National Park in Riau, Sumatra (a mood, not an ingredient source): bergamot, juniper and cypress; rose, jasmine and cedar; guaiac wood. By Benjamin Foatelli, 2024. Reported Rp325.000 / 50 ml on its own shop (out of stock), Rp322.800 at a retailer.

name: Casa de Vayu (Maya)
lead: Indian house; Maya is a 25% molecular skin scent (Ambermor, Sanjinol, Bacdanol) creators layer for a clean, soapy effect. ₹900 / 10 ml, ₹2,200 / 50 ml on its own shop.

name: Indian budget picks (fragrancefind)
lead: An Indian creator's mood picks under mall prices: Ombre Bliss Vanilla Kiss (vanilla, rum, oud), Embarouq Urban Oud, Panache, Nykaa Moi (Silver Pear, Amour, Joie de Vivre, Raison d'Être), XLNC Azure Blue, Café Drops, Zebaish Tiramisu S'mores, Fragan Baked Vanilla, Sharon Beauty Sea Side, Alternate Scents Lust, Fastrack Celeb. Find prices.

name: Pictura Fragrans (In From the Cold)
lead: Memory of a late-Cold-War winter kitchen: snow, spearmint, black tea and hyssop; tuberose, old books, toast and steam; cedar, opoponax, musk and rice pudding. US$234 / 50 ml, US$119 / 15 ml (currency per an AI check); extrait, sometimes out of stock.

name: Hédonisme (Skinny Dip N°22)
lead: Bergamot and vanilla, an earthy-mossy heart, honey base. Budget Spanish-retail line: reported €12.99 (€8.99 on sale) at Primor.

name: Flor de Mayo (Ice Cream Vainilla)
lead: Budget Spanish house (often mistaken for Mexican). Ice Cream Vainilla in a cone bottle: coconut, milk and pineapple; jasmine and lily of the valley; chocolate, musk and vanilla. Reported €3.95 for a mini colonia on its own shop (min. 5 units online).

name: Jousset Parfums (Donut Crave)
lead: Frosted-vanilla donut extrait by Jimmy Bodin: icing, milk foam and powdered sugar; fried dough and vanilla cream; vanilla, tonka and caramelised sugar. Reported €159 / 50 ml on its own shop, US$165 at Luckyscent.

name: Skin & Body Shop (Gardenia Powder)
lead: Small handmade shop: Gardenia Powder as a 30 ml perfume, a hair-and-body oil and a musk roll-on. Find price and location.

name: Osmo x Sai De Silva (P.S. Never Forgotten)
lead: Memory-inspired EDP built around patchouli (her late mother's scent), with smoked incense and Bulgarian rose, made with Osmo; the Instagram post credits Christophe Laudamiel. Find price.

name: House of Iyrah (823)
lead: Raspberry and bouvardia; jasmine, tuberose and karo karounde; damson plum, mahogany and amber. US$200 / 50 ml, US$70 / 15 ml, US$15 / 2 ml sample on its own shop (100 ml US$300, sold out).

name: Plum perfumes roundup (parfumpixie)
lead: Small-house plum picks (prices from an AI check): d'Annam Tokyo Nights, umeshu plum wine, osmanthus, amber, tobacco, US$160 / 50 ml (out of stock); Curatrix Heist, cherry, plum, jasmine, vanilla, US$190; Obvious Plum Cream, salty umeboshi plum, rum, davana, €95 / 50 ml (€36 / 10 ml). Blind Barber Only You, Babe: star anise and red plum, clove and saffron with a saffiano-leather accord, birch tar, sandalwood and musk; US$98 / 50 ml on its own shop (checked).

name: The Scent Arena (Muse Gourmand Series)
lead: Nigerian seller's 100 ml gourmand line (e.g. Marshmallow Dream, soft and creamy). Estimated ₦10,500–12,000 per bottle: ₦10,500 at The Scent Arena and ₦12,000 at another seller (prices seen in posts, not checked on a shop). Maker still to confirm.

name: Discount-store gourmands (US)
lead: Seen on TJ Maxx-style shelves, 100 ml: Jean Marc Paris De Gourmand Chocolate Caramel Cream (chocolate, caramel, tonka on the label; the brand's sister scent Chocolate Cream is reported at US$85 retail), The Good Scent Whipped Chocolate (cocoa meringue, whipped vanilla, hazelnut musk), Noted. Chocolate Musk (Noted. is a budget line by the French house Parfums Aubusson; the brand name is printed faintly above the label. The line, including Vanilla Fleur, Rock Candy and Velvet Bouquet, is reported at about US$45–60 retail and US$20–35 at discount stores; no brand shop found, sold on Amazon), Vanilla Potion. Far cheaper at discount stores.

name: scent x scent Fleurish (Five Below)
lead: New budget line: hair & body mists (236 ml) and 30 ml EDT gift sets. Velvet Berry (blackberry, amber woods), Whipped Milk (coconut cream, vanilla mousse), Cozy Vanilla (sugar crystals, cashmere vanilla). About US$5 per mist.

name: Attars a creator swears by (India)
lead: Kannauj Distillery Gulab (handmade rose attar, alcohol-free), Mir Perfumery Purple Tahara (Delhi Gate, New Delhi), Fiza Perfume Kashmiri Oud, Asaar Fragrances Asaar Oud, Ajmal Aurum. Find prices.

name: Itr by Arah (Musk Tahara oils)
lead: Nigerian seller's sweet musk tahara oils: Tulip Chocolate Cookies, Candy, Khamrah-style spicy-sweet, White Hot Chocolate. ₦2,500 / 3 ml, ₦4,000 / 6 ml, ₦7,000 / 12 ml, ₦17,000 / 30 ml (seller's post; images look AI-made).

name: Chocolate perfumes on a budget
lead: Creator picks with euro prices: Al Rehab Choco Musk (≈€6 oil, €15 spray; vanilla fluff with cocoa powder, the oil is creamier and lasts), Lattafa Nebras (≈€35, vanilla with cacao and berries), Theodoros Kalotinis Velvet Chocolate (≈€45, gooey brownie), by/Rosie Jane Dulce (≈€60, white-chocolate vanilla), Maison Tahité Vicious Cacao (≈€75, boozy hot chocolate). Others: Al-Nuaim Chocolate Musk (alcohol-free roll-on and spray), Al Rehab Choco Musk Pistachio and Marshmallow, Gulf Orchid Musk Collection Toffee, Paris Corner Qissa Delicious, Grandeur Tubbees Chocolate Fudge.

name: Qafila Naar Al Attar
lead: Cognac, caramel and woods in a desert-caravan box, 100 ml EDP. Find maker and price.

name: Prestige Cosmetics (Lagos)
lead: Lagos fragrance, body and home-care maker (4 Cosharis Street, Kirikiri). Its own lines include Fashionisto and Blue Dream perfumes and Broad Street bakhoor, with sub-brands Get Me, Noor Iman and My Way. Mostly sells through retailers and doesn't publish prices, and the Muse Gourmand series is not listed there, so the link to The Scent Arena's bottles is unconfirmed.

name: Indian hair perfumes (Saavi, Sacred Grove)
lead: Creator's clean hair-perfume picks: Saavi Silk Goddess and Fresh Strands (juicy berry), 30 ml; Sacred Grove Rani Baug (damask rose and peony), 50 ml; Asmira Naseem (sweet fruity floral). Find prices.

name: Al Rehab Choco Musk trio
lead: Choco Musk now has siblings: Choco Musk Pistachio and Marshmallow (6 ml oils, also sprays). Creators find the originals sweet, powdery vanilla-cocoa; the new ones need time to settle. Cheap and everywhere.

name: Swiss Arabian perfume oils
lead: Creator-favourite concentrated oils for layering: Musk 07, Secret Oud, Private Musk, Vanilla, Tonka. Commenters also love Ajmal Musk Silk and Paris Corner Confection oil. Find prices.
